enemy.name: 'Echoes'
enemy.flavour_text: A lingering beat, a dull echo. Who conducts it, and why does it sing?

abilities.text: Must be attacked several times to defeat
Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
[Polytonality]: Switches between [Golden Wail] and [Penumbral Lament] forms
ASPD increased in [Golden Wail] form, transforms into [Penumbral Lament] form after taking damage several times
Movement Speed is reduced while ATK is increased in [Penumbral Lament] form, transforms into [Golden Wail] form after taking damage several times
Upon taking damage, deals Arts damage in an area around itself, inflicting Necrosis
All <'Echoes'> periodically play in ensemble, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
